comments.author: Beatrice
comments.body:
Mostly level 40 NPC's here, some 45's.

Directions, based on the Korean characters map..

Red marker, east location, is entrance/exit.

Flower-red is at North. It's a dead end.

Diagonal Boulder in in North East. Lots of NPC's

Large Boulder is the more central location.

Swamp is in the south east location.

comments.author: Mark
comments.body: Collection Level 10: Green Ore, Bark, Rubber, Large Leaves, Common Grass. Swamp provides better results for Green Ore

comments.author: Teyla
comments.body: In between the large boulder and the swamp, you can discover an 'Iridescent cloud'. I'm not sure when it occurs.
